item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa'i grol phug gsas mkhar spyi dril gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las/ man ngag skabs kyi yig chung 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyi mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnags pa/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi smar byang / mkhas pa chen po de yis byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag rgya bo la grub pa bsnyes nas/ shin tu zab par mdzad ste/ bka' ni gsang ba'i brag rus sbal 'gying ba 'dra ba la/ bka' rtags mtshal gyi g.yung drung gis rgyas gdab nas sbas/ man ngag ni stong (stang) chen dmu tsha nyid kyi thugs la gab po/ phyis su rten 'brel skabs su bab pa'i dus kyi snyigs ma'i dka' thub pa/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi bka' yi pho nya/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'jug dus mtha'i kho bo bdag la dngos grub gnang ba 'di yang / spyang 'phags dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' gsungs phab pa dang dad ldan rnams kyi gsung gis yang yang bskur (bskul) ba'i ngor/ grub dbang bla ma'i gdan sa dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ lo dus kyi gsang rgya yol ba dang / bon bstan spel ba'i gnas su gyur bas/ stang chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du yi ger phab pa'o/ dge des bon bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
